<section begin="seo" />{{#seo:
|title=<%~ it.name %>
|description=<%~ it.seoDescription %>
|image=<%~ it.icon %>
|image_alt=<%~ it.name %> icon
|twitter_card=summary
}}<section end="seo" />
<section begin="infobox" />{{Infobox planet
|name=<%~ it.name %>
|api_name=<%~ it.apiName %>
|icon=<%~ it.icon %>
<% if (it.subtitle) { -%>
|subtitle=<%~ it.subtitle %>
<% } -%>
|min_level=<%= it.minLevel %>
|hazardous=<%~ it.hazardous %>
|regions=<%= it.regionCount %>
<% if (it.dailyModifierRegion) { -%>
|daily_modifier_region=<%~ it.dailyModifierRegion %>
<% } -%>
}}<section end="infobox" />
<% if (it.hasRegions) { %>
<section begin="regions" />
<%~ it.regionsSection -%>

<section end="regions" />
<% } -%>
<% if (it.hasMissions) { %>
<section begin="missions" />
<%~ it.missionsSection -%>

<section end="missions" />
<% } -%>

<includeonly><section begin="categories" />
[[Category:Planets]]
<section end="categories" /></includeonly>

[[Category:Auto-generated planet source pages]]
